t: This is Highbury Park, a street in Highbury that runs from Blackstock Road in the north down to Highbury Grove in the south. Thomas Wilson, who lived from 1731 to 1794, lived on this street. He appears in the Peerage records, which is how his name has come down to us. The material gives no more about him, so I will stay with what is known: an eighteenth-century resident of this part of Highbury.
